## Features
- Set of 10 acrylic icicle lights (3m lit length)
- 40 LEDs (Choice of White or Warm White)
- Timer function (6 hours On/18 hours Off)
- Outdoor-safe battery pack with 50cm cable
- Requires 4 x AA batteries (not included)

## Information
Add a bright, enchanting glow to your home this Christmas with these Battery Operated Icicle Lights from Christow. Suitable for indoors and outdoors, the string lights contain 10 hanging icicles, beautifully lit by 40 flashing LEDs. With a lit length of 3m, they look fabulous adding a festive glow to rooflines and guttering. Plus, they come in choice of colours to suit your festive theme and create your dream display. 10 x Acrylic LED Icicles Light string contains five large icicles, each containing five LEDs, and five small icicles, each containing three LEDs. The icicles have a clear acrylic construction for a bright, enchanting glow. Plus, a white painted finish on top to create a melting ice effect. Flash Memory Function Love a bit of festive sparkle? Select from 8 light sequences, ranging from twinkly effects to a normal static glow. For convenience, we've also added a memory chip. So, the lights will always remember the last setting selected when turned back on. Timer Function No need to worry about turning the lights on and off each night. Simply turn them on at your desired time when first using them. After that, they'll automatically light up at the same time every night. Plus, they'll automatically turn off after six hours. Outdoor-Safe Battery Pack Powered by 4 x AA batteries with an outdoor-safe IP44-rated battery box. Gives you the freedom to display the lights anywhere, inside or outside your home. Battery box has a 50cm clear cable. So, you can easily hide it behind nearby objects or foliage. 1442093.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Ip65 weatherproof led string lights
- Connectable up to 100m lighting system
- Durable cable for indoor outdoor use

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features
- Heavy-duty white rubber cable, waterproof
- Connectable up to 50m for custom displays
- Energy-saving leds with warm white glow

## Information
Create a magical atmosphere with these Cool White LED Icicle Lights, designed with a striking 60/40/20cm drop pattern and finished on durable white rubber cable. Part of our mains voltage light system, these icicle lights are built for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile option for year-round decoration. With the ability to connect multiple sets together, you can easily tailor the length to suit anything from a small porch or pergola to a full house frontage. Manufactured with heavy-duty rubber cable and waterproof ends, these icicle lights are weather-resistant and suitable for all seasons. The long-life LED bulbs provide a bright yet cool glow that enhances the charm of your outdoor or indoor setting, while also being energy efficient and reliable. Available in 2m and 5m sections, these connectable lights allow you to achieve up to 50m of continuous display with ease. Perfect for adding elegance to gutters, eaves, patios, garden structures or festive displays, they are equally at home enhancing summer evenings as they are creating a festive winter scene. Whether you choose to install them permanently or bring them out for special occasions, these Cool White Icicle Lights are designed to deliver long-lasting performance and an inviting glow that transforms any space.

8044293.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Non-replaceable LEDs
- Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use
- Mains Operated
- 8 available functions
- 8 hours on / 16 hours off timer function
- ECO-friendly LEDs

## Information
Elevate your indoor or outdoor Christmas ambience with these mains-operated 38.3m SupaBrights. Adorned with 480 red and gold energy-efficient LEDs spaced approximately 8cm apart on a resilient green cable, they effortlessly blend into various festive settings. The 8m lead from the plug to the initial bulb ensures easy placement. Adjust the lighting effects with a quick press of the button on the transformer, offering options like static, combination, waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade, and twinkle/flash. To enhance energy efficiency, employ the 8-hour on / 16-hour off timer function by holding down the button until it lights green. The built-in memory chip ensures your chosen settings are preserved. These lights are perfect for indoor and temporary outdoor use, but ensure the IP20-rated transformer remains dry at all times for safe operation.
